decision_evidence: The project owner instructed the agent to continue the recommended beta-critical route until complete. The selected reversible route is limited to acquiring and statically reviewing official UMass LFW protocol documents; it does not authorize dataset, image, detector, model, matcher, or scientific execution.
permitted_actions: Retrieve the two named official UMass LFW protocol PDF documents over HTTPS into the QualSight resource-evidence directory.
Preserve response headers and compute cryptographic hashes, sizes, and retrieval timestamps.
Use the exact pinned local pdftotext executable to extract protocol text for deterministic static validation.
Classify the planned study conservatively against the official protocol categories while retaining every unresolved predicate.
prohibited_actions: Do not decode or display an LFW image.
Do not load or execute a detector, model, matcher, or OFIQ runtime.
Do not infer dataset-image rights, consent, acquisition provenance, or redistribution permission from protocol documents.
Do not claim complete official-protocol conformance without matcher-training identity-exclusion evidence and authorized resources.
